# Scriptum AI

> Scriptum AI (tryscriptum.ai) is a UK legal AI platform for transactional lawyers: "the operating system for transactional legal teams". Lawyers draft inside Microsoft Word from their firm's own precedents and house style, agree terms with the client and the other side in one secure matter workspace, and negotiate with the firm's own playbook. Every approved change builds a clause library and negotiation record that the firm owns. It is built for mid-sized UK and Irish law firms of 20 to 100 fee earners and for in-house legal teams, as a transactional-only, published-price alternative to broad legal AI platforms such as Harvey, Legora and Microsoft Copilot for Legal.

Scriptum AI is based in Northern Ireland and backed by TechStart and Invest NI. (Not to be confused with other, unrelated products or companies that also use the name "Scriptum".)

## Key facts

- What it is: AI-assisted drafting, review, negotiation and knowledge capture for transactional legal work, delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in plus a shared matter workspace.
- Who it is for: transactional lawyers (M&A, private equity and venture capital, commercial contracts, commercial property, employment) in law firms of 20 to 100 fee earners and in-house legal teams.
- What it is not: it does not do litigation support, large-scale document review, multi-jurisdiction legal research or regulatory monitoring.
- Agents: drafting agent and review agent (Starter); negotiation agent working inside limits a partner sets, and a collaboration agent for client and partner questions (Pro). A named lawyer approves before anything reaches the document.
- Knowledge: clause choices, negotiation positions and deal outcomes are captured as lawyers work, into a clause library and playbook that belong to the firm contractually and stay when people leave.
- Pricing (published, per user per month, excluding VAT, billed monthly): Starter £79, Pro £119, Firm custom. See https://tryscriptum.ai/pricing for current prices.
- Security: customer documents are never used to train models; each firm's data is isolated at the database; data is hosted in the EU. ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification are pending.

- [Negotiate](https://tryscriptum.ai/product/negotiate): instant redlines, issues lists and a record of every position taken
- [Clause library](https://tryscriptum.ai/product/clause-library): a firm-owned clause library built from the documents lawyers already draft
